name: weighted sandbag deadlift
description: A deadlift with a sandbag, building hip and back strength with an awkward, grippy load.
instructions: Stand over a sandbag with feet hip width apart.
Hinge at your hips, bend your knees and grip the bag.
Brace your core and drive through your feet to stand tall with the bag.
Push your hips back and lower the bag to the floor.
